user.title: Techem tenant portal
user.description: Log in at mieter.techem.de, open the browser's developer tools → Storage/Application → Cookies → mieter.techem.de and copy the value of `__Secure-next-auth.session-token` (or paste the whole Cookie header).

reauth_confirm.title: Techem session expired
reauth_confirm.description: Log in at mieter.techem.de again and paste a fresh `__Secure-next-auth.session-token` cookie.

error.bad_cookie: No session cookie found in the pasted text.
error.invalid_auth: The portal rejected this cookie (expired or logged out).
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach or read the Techem portal.

abort.already_configured: This Techem account is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: This cookie belongs to a different Techem account.

init.title: Heating model
init.description: The model spreads each monthly Techem value over the hours of the month and forecasts the current month. Weather (outdoor temperature and solar radiation) comes from Open-Meteo; only your home coordinates rounded to ~10 km are sent. Radiator valve sensors (position in %) make the hourly split follow when your radiators were actually open; they need long-term statistics (state_class: measurement).

data.weather: Use Open-Meteo weather (needed for the model and forecast)
